description: Risk levels offered by the recommendation UI and API (Task 15 Part A). Each level maps to a policy evaluated in the final test. The mapping was fixed by the team on 2026-11-16 from the policy definitions, not tuned on test results. Mean and ML are not risk levels: Mean has no safety margin and ML alone under-provisions too often (report Section 7).

risk_levels.label: Restrictive
risk_levels.description: Lower violation risk and more capacity reserved.

risk_levels.label: Balanced
risk_levels.description: Middle point in the violation/waste trade-off.

risk_levels.label: Efficient
risk_levels.description: Lower waste with a higher chance of exceeded runs.
